item.title: Poland's prime minister warns of Russian 'accidental' attacks on Ukraine's allies
item.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said that these potential strikes "intend to paralyze NATO" in an attempt to demonstrate that Article 5 "exists only in theory."

item.title: What to know after a week of Houthi attacks that threaten Saudi oil
item.description: The Houthis' biggest land grab in years reignited Yemen's 12-year civil war and pushed up global fuel prices, extending their reach to a key maritime chokepoint and threatening Saudi Arabia's oil exports.

item.title: To prevent deaths in childbirth, Kenyan moms turn to an AI powered chatbot
item.description: Many questions come up during pregnancy. Is swelling normal? Are avocados safe to eat? For folks in Kenya who don't have a search engine at their fingertips, a chatbot is offering a lifeline.

item.title: U.N.-backed experts cite possible U.S. war crimes in Iran, including a school attack
item.description: Human rights experts commissioned by the U.N. say they have found "reasonable grounds" to believe the U.S. committed war crimes in Iran, including a strike on a school in the southern city of Minab.

item.title: Pressure on global chokepoints drives Asia's increased use of Arctic Trade Routes
item.description: Asian nations began pilot voyages over a decade ago to find routes to Europe and the Middle East that were faster and less vulnerable to chokepoints. The ongoing war has added impetus to those efforts.
